title: rubus caesius var. serpens
intro: Rubus caesius var. serpens, commonly known as the wild black raspberry or blue arctic raspberry, is a type of edible and medicinal plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rubus caesius var. serpens include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-irritant, making it useful for wound healing and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
